edge_explainer.market_believes: Beijing has come for Futu: a $271M fine, the CEO personally penalized, a class action, and a mainland wind-down — the first shoe of a DiDi-style campaign that could end with delisting.
edge_explainer.we_believe: The primary sources describe the opposite: a pre-announced, industry-wide, two-year rectification CONCLUDING conduct that was frozen back in 2022 — a bounded monetary settlement on a franchise whose ex-mainland engine grew 30%+ right through it, with a fortress balance sheet buying back stock into the crash.
edge_explainer.why_we_might_have_edge: The market prices the bull at ~11%; the verified pattern (Ant-style conclusion, trivial VIE, fungible HK primary listing, aligned insiders) supports ~30%. The mispricing is a base-rate error on Chinese enforcement patterns — checkable, mechanistic, and dated.
edge_explainer.why_it_might_be_priced_in: If the final determination adds restrictions or a second front opens, the ~59% implied bear weight was right and cheap was correct — the tail is real, only its probability is disputed.
edge_explainer.what_resolves_it: The final CSRC determination (Q3-Q4) and the ~late-Aug Q2 print (overseas offset visible).
edge_explainer.mechanism_falsifier: Any kill trigger firing — especially a new enforcement vector or the final penalty exceeding the pre-notice — flips this from conclusion to campaign and the bear dominates.
edge_explainer.edge_type: base-rate mispricing on a dated, verifiable enforcement resolution; UNLEVERED only (political tail)

red_team_adjudication_2026_07_02.verdict: DOWNGRADE: 7/10 BUY 3-4% -> 4/10 WAIT with defined re-entry. The skeptic's central attack LANDS: the trailing P/E denominator contains peak-of-everything earnings (record HK volumes 2.3x midcycle, cycle-high rates, risk-appetite-peak margin balances) PLUS ~20% mainland revenue legally mandated into sell-only decay. 9.2x trailing is NOT the real multiple.
red_team_adjudication_2026_07_02.adjudicated_normalization: Skeptic says HK$5-7bn normalized NI (15-21x); verifier shows no 2022-23 revenue trough + accounts 2.4x since. MY NUMBER: HK$7-9bn (13-17x) — the skeptic's 35-40% brokerage haircut applies HKEX's 2.3x cycle to a book that is ~72% US-traded volume (Q1: US 3.0tn of 4.15tn total), and static normalization ignores the +34% account-growth vector that refills during the mean-reversion window. Honest edge after normalization: +5-15pp with wide bands — INSIDE NOISE at $95 given the China tail stack.
skeptic_findings_accepted: PEAK-EARNINGS: FY25 NI +108% on a record-volume year — trailing multiple is fake-cheap (KILL of the valuation leg as underwritten)

'CONCLUSION' was factually wrong: it is a PRE-notification, proposed, 'rectify or cease' — bounded-monetary is still the base case (symmetric industry treatment, symbolic RMB1.25M personal fines, de-escalatory June clarification) but NOT concluded
SELL-ONLY mechanics: existing mainland clients frozen to sells immediately — revenue decays much faster than a linear 2-yr glide (margin interest + buy turnover die first)
Mainland perimeter: ID-document-based classification excludes economically-mainland cohorts; 25-30% is the right planning number, not 20%
Net-cash overstated: borrowings HK$15.7bn ~ the claimed $2.1bn own cash; much of it is FRR-required liquid capital, NOT distributable — QUANTIFY before any entry
Buyback mischaracterized: $418M is CUMULATIVE since Nov-2025, much bought at $150-200 pre-crash — weaker signal than 'bought into the crash'
Tencent 20% overhang: no lockup/standstill found; sold once already (Sept-2024)
Rate sensitivity bracket 6-14% of NI (verifier 6-7% @-100bps deposit-line-only; skeptic 10-14% @-150-200bps)
skeptic_overreaches_rejected: 35-40% brokerage haircut uses HK-cycle math on a 72%-US-volume book
